## Batch 4 authored

The A lemma proves the normed-subspace and finite-basis realification claims, including the zero-dimensional case, without choice. The B example verifies the line spanned by \((1,i)\) and its real basis \(((1,i),(i,-1))\).

The assigned draft items, pages, manifest, proof contracts, coverage, cross-batch evidence, notes, and readiness records are in place. Both items’ Step 1 records are `ready`—this records author readiness, not independent acceptance. Full-text reading and fetch evidence are recorded in the [coverage file](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-prerequisites-4-2026-10-15-batch-4.coverage.json): [Kochanek’s Lecture 1](https://www.impan.pl/~tkoch/FA_lecturenotes/lecture1.pdf) supports the norm and metric conventions; [Moslehian et al., §2.1](https://d-nb.info/1261144333/34) treats realification and the induced basis.

Scoped checks passed: precheck (2 items), rendercheck (4 files), focused depcheck, content policy, item and batch dependency levels, source fetch (2/2), and proof layout (11 steps, no defects).

## Owner handoff notes

- `plan-spec.json` has empty item arrays for these pages, while the assigned design specifies the lemma and example. This discrepancy is documented in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-prerequisites-4-2026-10-15-batch-4-scaffold-notes.md).
- Recomputing the batch dependency artifact preserved the graph—batch 4 remains level 1 and requires batch 2—but changed its input hash to `d9174154…`. The task retains the original dispatch hash `7a9fade1…`; both are documented in the notes.
- The B readiness record’s reason says “C-supremum norm”; the example uses the coordinate \(\ell^1\) norm. The notes record the correction. The decision tool prevents a non-owner from replacing the ready record.
- An unsupported `--help` probe accidentally invoked read-only whole-library `depcheck` and `rendercheck` runs. I did not use those outputs as batch evidence; the scoped checks above are the relevant results.

I did not change published content or `.autopilot` state.
